Overview

Aberdeen is a city in Scotland with a population of 228,000. Scotland’s oil capital on the North Sea coast, a granite city known for its historic architecture, thriving energy sector, and proximity to stunning castles and whisky trails. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 140 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
